♦️ **FLEX GUI PRO V9.3.0 EBIMI! (AFTER EFFECTS)**

**MAP RIGS 2.0**, AutoCaptions na script na yo moko (**Your script**) mpe **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe**, mpe **Flex Studio (Beta)** oyo ekitisamaka liboso mpe etunaka yo liboso ya kotyama.

*(Tya yango likolo ya version na yo ya sikawa mpe fungola lisusu After Effects mbala moko.)*

♦️ **Ya sika: MAP RIGS 2.0**
* Ebongiseli ya **Map desk**, boluki bisika kozanga internet, **Quick looks** (Country Pop, Space Dive, Trip Route mpe mosusu), Stick to Map, Clean labels, Always Sharp, ba style ya karte ya ofele mpe **Open in Flex Maps**.
* Bisaleli na yango ya kobakisa (sync ya mbala moko, ba style, ba label, 3D, Finalize) sikawa efungwamaka solo kati na After Effects.

♦️ **Ya sika na AutoCaptions**
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (na cloud, esalelaka ba crédit ya Flex AI) ezali motore oyo tolendisi, eponami mbala moko mpo na bato nyonso. Pona lisusu Whisper mpo na kosala ba sous-titre ya ofele na ordinateur na yo (Translate To esengeli Whisper). Soki serveur ezali na mosala mingi, emonisaka esika na yo na molongo.
* **Your script**: ba sous-titre ezwaka ndenge ya kokoma mpe maloba ya script na yo bisika nyonso oyo olobaki maloba wana.
* Kobimisa na **Editable template**: ba sous-titre lokola ba layer ya template oyo okoki kobongola style na yango na Essential Properties (After Effects 2026).
* Eloko moko te eponami mpe Source media ezali mpamba? Epesaka yo **composition mobimba**. Audio moko ezongelaka transcription na yango.

♦️ **Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** ekitisaka application, sima etunaka **Install / Not now**.
* Application (2.0.0-beta.2): bisika ya mosala **PRO, TRACK, ROTOSCOPE, COLOR GRADING**, ba touche ya bisaleli ya After Effects, ba clip efungwamaka mbala moko, mpe OPEN esalaka na ba precomp mpe ba adjustment layer.

♦️ **Ebongisami**
* Ba effet ya thème oyo ezalaki kozanga na ba PC mingi ya Windows ezongi (ya pete koleka soki ba effet ya animation ya Windows ekangami).

♦️ **Esika (location) ya kopona mpo na kobatela licence**
* Tokotuna yo kaka mbala moko, mpe ezali ya kopona: na **No thanks** makambo nyonso ekobi kosala. Okoki kobongola yango na **Flex Settings > Privacy**. Ebombamaka sanza 12, batekaka yango soki moke te, mpe bakabolaka yango te longola kaka soki mobeko esengi yango.

ult.message:
♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V2.3.0 EBIMI! (PREMIERE PRO)**

**Caption Stack ekoti na AutoCaptions** na ba style, ba ebongiseli, ba animation mpe ba son mpo na liloba moko moko. **UN-NEST** mpe ba blend mode esalaka na Premiere 26.5, **AUTO CUT** ezali kofina mbala moko kaka, mpe **Flex Studio (Beta)** efungolaka clip na yo uta na panel.

*(Tya yango likolo ya version na yo ya sikawa mpe fungola lisusu Premiere Pro mbala moko.)*

♦️ **Ya sika: Ba sous-titre ya animation na AutoCaptions**
* **Style ya liloba**: pesa liloba nyonso balangi na yango moko, police mpe finition Flat, Shine to Glow.
* **Ebongiseli ya molongo**: Stack, Over, Under, Beside mpe Line.
* **Animation mpo na liloba moko moko** (Fade, Pop, Rise, Type, Shake mpe mosusu) na preview, mpe lisusu ba son **Pop / Tick / Swoosh**. Ba style ya maloba mpe animation esengeli sortie **Images**.
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (na cloud, esalelaka ba crédit ya Flex AI) sikawa ezali motore oyo tolendisi, eponami mbala moko mpo na bato nyonso; pona motore Whisper mpo na kosala ba sous-titre ya ofele kozanga internet.
* **Your script** (mode Captions): ba sous-titre ezwaka maloba ya script na yo esika oyo olobaki maloba wana.
* Soki eloko moko te eponami (carte Source ezali mpamba), epesaka **timeline mobimba**; ba sous-titre ebombamaka pembeni ya projet na yo.

♦️ **Ya sika: Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Open in Flex Studio** elandaka clip na kati ya application; **APPLY TO PREMIERE** ezongisaka track. Etyami te? **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** ekitisaka yango, sima etunaka **Install / Not now**.

♦️ **Ebongwani**
* **AUTO CUT** etalelaka clip oyo eponami mpe ekataka na kofina mbala moko. **Retakes** ekangaka milongo oyo obandaki lisusu.
* **Audio Studio** sikawa ezali na ba sous-onglet motoba. **Library** sikawa ezali na Nest Saver.

♦️ **Ebongisami**
* **UN-NEST** na Premiere 26.5 (ezalaki koboya nest nyonso), mpe ba blend mode lokola Screen oyo ezalaki kozonga na Normal (Premiere na Lingelesi).
* Chip ya motane ya **AUTOSAVE 0:00**, preview ya moindo ya Caption Stack, mpe ba effet ya thème oyo ezalaki kozanga na ba PC mingi ya Windows.

♦️ **Esika (location) ya kopona mpo na kobatela licence**
* Tokotuna yo kaka mbala moko, mpe ezali ya kopona: na **No thanks** makambo nyonso ekobi kosala. Okoki kobongola yango na **Flex Settings > Privacy**. Ebombamaka sanza 12, batekaka yango soki moke te, mpe bakabolaka yango te longola kaka soki mobeko esengi yango.
